recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, two-person portrait featuring a high-contrast character dynamic. One subject is a male with exaggerated facial features and a wide, awkward expression wearing a patterned knit sweater; the other is a female in profile, softly kissing his cheek. The composition uses warm, golden-hour lighting and a clean, off-white background to frame the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition between the male's direct, wide-eyed gaze and the female's soft, closed-eye profile.
Textual layering where the main title overlaps the male's hair and forehead.
Color coordination between the red title text and the female's dark burgundy clothing.
coreInvariants: Tight headshot framing with minimal background visible.
Warm, saturated skin tones with soft-focus edges.
Three-tier typographic hierarchy: main title, secondary names, and bottom metadata.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male subject is centered and large-scale, occupying the left two-thirds; the female subject is in profile on the right, scaled slightly smaller.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The male subject's eyes and the point of contact (the kiss) on the cheek.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title text, moves down to the male's eyes, follows the kiss to the female's profile, and ends at the bottom horizontal text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, concentrated at the top corners and the very bottom edge.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and skin tones providing a soft, approachable feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep burgundy and black in the clothing to ground the composition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red in the primary title to draw immediate attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with a soft, diffused light value that minimizes harsh shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and primary red

letterConstructionRules: Lower-case primary title with tight kerning
High stroke contrast in the serif faces
Drop shadows applied to the main title for depth against hair textures
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first word of the title is colored red, while the second is white with a thin black outline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform serif family with weight and color variation to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal text alignment at the bottom to frame the image.

preserve: Lowercase styling for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slab-serif weight and rounded terminals of the main title.
Appropriate for the secondary names and bottom metadata for a classic look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with curly hair and a wide, awkward smile wearing a patterned cream sweater, being kissed on the cheek by a blonde woman in profile. Use warm, soft lighting against a plain light background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase serif text at the top, with the first word in red and the second in white with a black outline. Place actor names in white serif below that, and a full-width line of all-caps serif text at the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the first word of the title red?
Is the text at the bottom all-caps and centered?
Does the title overlap the male subject's hair?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the title

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subjects' faces

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the kiss contact point is clearly visible.
Check that the red text is legible against the hair.
Verify the bottom text spans the width of the composition.
Confirm the overall mood is lighthearted and comedic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast character duo (awkward vs. graceful) in a tight crop with warm lighting and bold, lowercase serif typography for a classic romantic comedy aesthetic.
